implementation.targetScope: Single-lane horizontal/vertical Material React Table virtualization: range extraction, keyed dynamic sizes, scrolling/alignment, snapshots, element/window observers, owner-window cleanup and React adapter lifecycle. Masonry lanes, end anchoring/follow-on-append and iOS momentum correction are outside this package scope.

changes: Zero runtime dependencies; independently written typed geometry storage and lazy visible-item objects.
Options are copied without deleting caller fields; invalid geometry is rejected.
Queued callbacks and scroll reconciliation are owned by the attached window and cancelled on teardown.
Explicit unsupported-mode errors instead of silently returning an incorrect masonry or chat layout.

caller.name: material-react-table
caller.note: MRT enables virtualization through its options; current app call sites do not explicitly enable these options. This is an existing table-stack dependency, not a claim of active production virtualization.
